alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A pink dining room. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes proudly shows off a new planner on the table, stretching tall with chimes. A royal blue figure watches with wide eyes, then narrows them, then closes its eyes and dozes off standing. The ink-black figure's eyes go wide and it grows taller, triumphant, then narrows its eyes at the camera. The text stays: bought a planner. it's november. next year i will.
